item.title: Impact On and Off the Pitch With Farkhunda Muhtaj
item.description: On the latest episode of our podcast Alright, Now What?, Farkhunda Muhtaj, Afghan-Canadian professional footballer, Calgary Wild FC player, social activist, and humanitarian, joins our host, Shagana, and reflects on how access to sport can break down social barriers and create pathways for girls and young people.

item.title: Bonus episode: In Conversation With Diana Fox Carney
item.description: In this special bonus episode, Mitzie Hunter is joined by Madame Diana Fox Carney, an economist and climate expert whose work has taken her from Africa to the UK to here in Canada, and whose career has focused on tackling some of the biggest challenges of our time.

item.title: Standing with Friends and Feminists - Canadian Women's Foundation
item.description: From March 9 to 19, 2026, President and CEO Mitzie Hunter attended the 70th session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women. During this time, the Canadian Women’s Foundation hosted, participated, and listened in on key discussions with national and international peers. Mitzie has captured her reflections in a follow-up article.
